claims.quote: is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting

articles.source_title: Nvidia opens investigation after report CEO Jensen Huang was target of foreign intelligence
articles.summary_en: According to The Guardian's RSS summary, Nvidia said it would launch an independent investigation following reports that CEO Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. The NYT summary says senior US officials were concerned about his relationship with a woman allegedly tied to Chinese intelligence; 中央社's summary reports a fall in Nvidia shares in after-hours trading. 中央社 also reports that Donald Trump called Huang a man of integrity but had not spoken with him about allegations involving a Chinese female spy.
articles.summary_zh: 據《衛報》RSS摘要，輝達表示，因報導指執行長黃仁勳疑遭外國情報行動鎖定，將啟動獨立調查。《紐約時報》摘要稱，美國高層官員關切他與一名被指涉及中國情報活動女子的關係；中央社摘要則報導輝達盤後股價下跌。中央社另報導，川普稱黃仁勳「為人正直」，但尚未與他談過涉及中國女間諜的指控。

supporting_sources.source_title: 黃仁勳涉遭外國情報機構鎖定公司啟動調查　輝達盤後股價挫跌
Rubio Warned Officials About Nvidia Chief’s Entanglement With Chinese Spy
川普稱輝達執行長黃仁勳「為人正直」　盼外界聽取其說法

articles.title_en: Nvidia says it will investigate reports that Jensen Huang was targeted by foreign intelligence
articles.title_zh: 輝達稱啟動獨立調查，釐清黃仁勳疑遭外國情報鎖定報導

claims.quote: 世界進入極端氣候成為常態的新局面
呼籲出席土耳其「聯合國氣候變化綱要公約第31次締約方會議」（COP31）的各國領袖「認真應對」
remains heavily dependent on fossil fuels as it tries to inspire a global switch to clean energy.

articles.source_title: COP31土耳其召開　聯合國秘書長：世界進入極端氣候時代
articles.summary_en: According to 中央社's RSS summary, the UN secretary-general warned that the world had entered a new era in which extreme weather is the norm, urging leaders attending COP31 in Turkey to respond seriously. Deutsche Welle's summary notes that host Turkey remains heavily dependent on fossil fuels while seeking to encourage a global shift to clean energy.
articles.summary_zh: 據中央社RSS摘要，聯合國秘書長警告，世界已進入極端氣候成為常態的新局面，呼籲出席土耳其COP31的各國領袖認真應對。德國之聲摘要指出，主辦國土耳其雖試圖推動全球轉向潔淨能源，仍高度依賴化石燃料。

supporting_sources.source_title: Turkey pushes for transition at COP31 as coal burns

articles.title_en: UN chief warns of extreme weather becoming the norm as Turkey hosts COP31
articles.title_zh: COP31土耳其召開，聯合國秘書長警告極端氣候成常態

articles.source_title: Krakow mass shooting suspect has died in hospital, police in Poland say
articles.summary_en: According to DW's RSS summary, Polish authorities said the Krakow shooting suspect died in hospital from injuries sustained in a shootout with police. The BBC summary reports at least six people killed in the shooting and three bodies of the suspect's family members found at their home; FOX's summary reports six killed and 15 wounded in the shooting. Bloomberg's summary says authorities were still seeking clues to the motive.
articles.summary_zh: 據德國之聲RSS摘要，波蘭當局表示，克拉科夫槍擊案嫌犯因與警方交火受傷，於醫院死亡。BBC摘要稱槍擊造成至少6死，另在嫌犯家中發現3名家人遺體；FOX摘要報導槍擊造成6死15傷。彭博摘要指出，當局仍在追查犯案動機。

supporting_sources.source_title: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say
Gunman in Polish Mass Shooting Dies as Terrorism Probe Proceeds
Gunman who killed 6 in Poland's Krakow square dies in hospital after police shootout

articles.title_en: Krakow shooting suspect dies of injuries as authorities investigate motive
articles.title_zh: 波蘭克拉科夫槍擊案嫌犯傷重死亡，當局續查動機

claims.quote: 東北季風增強海象惡劣，中國4艘海警船今天下午再度編隊航入金門限制水域。
海巡署立即調派巡防艇前往，在強風大浪中以中、英文廣播，耗時2小時將4船全數驅離。

articles.editorial_analysis_zh: 此事件涉及金門限制水域的海巡執法，以及惡劣海象下的驅離作業。
articles.source_title: 中國4海警船頂惡劣海象擾金門　海巡廣播驅離
articles.summary_en: According to an RSS summary from 中央社, four Chinese coast guard ships entered Kinmen's restricted waters in formation amid rough seas caused by strengthening northeasterly winds. Taiwan's coast guard dispatched patrol boats and used broadcasts in Chinese and English, taking two hours to expel all four ships.
articles.summary_zh: 中央社RSS摘要指出，東北季風增強、海象惡劣之際，中國4艘海警船編隊航入金門限制水域。海巡署調派巡防艇，以中、英文廣播，耗時2小時將4船全數驅離。
articles.title_en: Four Chinese coast guard ships enter Kinmen restricted waters; patrols take two hours to expel them
articles.title_zh: 中國4艘海警船航入金門限制水域　海巡耗時2小時驅離

claims.quote: 台股今天收漲1960.06點，改寫史上次高紀錄，但外資仍連8賣
投顧分析，台股是否真正落底，仍須觀察美股走勢與外資後續動向。

articles.editorial_analysis_zh: 台股大漲與外資持續賣超同時出現；摘要引述的投顧分析仍將美股及外資後續動向列為觀察重點。
articles.source_title: 外資賣超台股逾900億元　調節聯電、台積電
articles.summary_en: According to an RSS summary from 中央社, Taiwan stocks closed up 1,960.06 points, while foreign investors remained net sellers for an eighth consecutive trading session. Investment advisory analysis cited in the summary said whether the market had truly bottomed still depended on subsequent U.S. stock performance and foreign investor activity.
articles.summary_zh: 中央社RSS摘要指出，台股收漲1960.06點，外資仍連續8個交易日賣超。摘要引述投顧分析，台股是否真正落底，仍須觀察美股走勢與外資後續動向。
articles.title_en: Taiwan stocks rise 1,960.06 points as foreign investors remain net sellers for eighth session
articles.title_zh: 台股收漲1960.06點　外資仍連8個交易日賣超

claims.quote: 財政部今天表示，今年全年出口表現可望締造3項歷史紀錄，首先是出口值可望衝破9000億美元關卡，刷新全年新高紀錄
第2是台灣出口值將超過日本；第3是出口世界排名可望「坐8望7」，自去年第12名大躍進

articles.editorial_analysis_zh: 財政部預估涉及全年出口值新高及世界排名提升，但仍屬預估，並非全年實績。
articles.source_title: 財部：今年台灣出口規模將超越日本　世界排名「坐8望7」
articles.summary_en: An RSS summary from 中央社 cited Taiwan's finance ministry as forecasting that annual exports could exceed US$900 billion this year, setting a record and surpassing Japan. The ministry also projected that Taiwan's global export ranking could rise from 12th last year to eighth, with a chance of reaching seventh.
articles.summary_zh: 中央社RSS摘要引述財政部預估，今年全年出口值可望突破9000億美元、創歷史新高，並超越日本。財政部也預期，台灣出口世界排名可望由去年的第12名升至第8名，並有望挑戰第7名。
articles.title_en: Finance ministry forecasts annual exports above US$900 billion, surpassing Japan
articles.title_zh: 財政部估全年出口值突破9000億美元　規模將超越日本

claims.quote: China will suspend retaliatory measures such as an additional 24% tariff on US goods for another two months,
formalizing a decision by the two countries’ leaders to prolong their trade truce until next January.

articles.source_title: China Extends Pause on US Tariffs and Trade Curbs for Two Months
articles.summary_en: According to Bloomberg Economics' RSS summary, China will extend the suspension of retaliatory measures, including an additional 24% tariff on US goods, for another two months. The move formalizes the two countries' leaders' decision to prolong their trade truce until next January.
articles.summary_zh: Bloomberg Economics的RSS摘要指出，中國將對美國商品加徵24%關稅等報復措施的暫停期限再延長兩個月。此舉將兩國領導人延長貿易休戰至明年1月的決定正式化。
articles.title_en: China extends suspension of additional 24% tariff on US goods and other retaliatory measures by two months
articles.title_zh: 中國將對美額外24%關稅等報復措施暫停期限再延兩個月

claims.quote: U.S.-led talks to end the war between Russia and Ukraine will resume this week in Abu Dhabi.
A cease-fire won’t be on the table.

articles.source_title: Ukraine Peace Talks Resume This Week in Abu Dhabi
articles.summary_en: According to NYT World's RSS summary, US-led talks aimed at ending the war between Russia and Ukraine will resume this week in Abu Dhabi. A cease-fire will not be on the agenda.
articles.summary_zh: NYT World的RSS摘要指出，美國主導、旨在結束俄烏戰爭的談判將於本週在阿布達比恢復。停火不在此次談判議程內。
articles.title_en: US-led Russia-Ukraine peace talks to resume this week in Abu Dhabi; cease-fire not on agenda
articles.title_zh: 美國主導俄烏和平談判本週於阿布達比恢復　停火不列議程

claims.quote: 今天宣布AI助理Gemini在台灣推出中文版購物功能。
使用者透過日常口語對話方式描述需求與預算，Gemini可直接生成商品圖卡，列出價格、評價、庫存、購買管道及規格比較表等細節

articles.source_title: Gemini中文版購物功能登台　對話式AI重塑網購行為
articles.summary_en: According to 中央社's RSS summary, Google announced Chinese-language shopping features for Gemini in Taiwan. Google says users can describe their needs and budgets in everyday language, and Gemini can generate product cards showing prices, reviews, stock availability, purchasing options and specification comparison tables.
articles.summary_zh: 中央社RSS摘要報導，Google宣布在台灣推出Gemini中文版購物功能。Google表示，使用者可用日常口語描述需求與預算，由Gemini產生商品圖卡，列出價格、評價、庫存、購買管道及規格比較表。
articles.title_en: Google announces Chinese-language Gemini shopping features in Taiwan
articles.title_zh: Google宣布Gemini中文版購物功能在台推出

claims.quote: Norway will suspend further reservation of electricity connections for data centers
while the country figures out how to handle the burden they place on the the grid.

articles.source_title: Norway Halts Power Connections for New Data Centers
articles.summary_en: According to a Bloomberg Markets RSS summary, Norway will suspend further reservations of electricity connections for data centers while assessing how to address the burden they place on the grid.
articles.summary_zh: 據Bloomberg Markets的RSS摘要，挪威將暫停為資料中心進一步預留電力連接，同時評估如何因應資料中心對電網造成的負擔。
articles.title_en: Norway to pause further power connection reservations for data centers
articles.title_zh: 挪威將暫停為資料中心新增預留電力連接　評估電網負擔

claims.quote: 韓國公平交易委員會今天以酷澎濫用其在餐飲外送市場的主導地位為由，對電商巨擘酷澎（Coupang）處以3009億韓元（約2億2059萬美元）罰款。

articles.source_title: 酷澎涉濫用餐飲外送市場主導地位　遭韓重罰2.2億美元
articles.summary_en: According to a 中央社 RSS summary, South Korea's fair trade commission fined Coupang 300.9 billion won (about US$220.59 million), citing abuse of its dominant position in the food delivery market.
articles.summary_zh: 中央社RSS摘要報導，韓國公平交易委員會以酷澎濫用餐飲外送市場主導地位為由，裁罰3009億韓元（約2億2059萬美元）。
articles.title_en: South Korean regulator fines Coupang 300.9 billion won, citing food delivery market abuse
articles.title_zh: 韓國主管機關指酷澎濫用餐飲外送市場地位　裁罰3009億韓元

claims.quote: We audit 25 biomedical domain fine-tuned large language models against 11 paired base checkpoints
median 8.3% on MedAbstain), falls further after fine-tuning (median 4.2%, decreasing in 21 of 25 pairs on MedAbstain)
heterogeneous across pairs

articles.source_title: Guardrail Erosion in Domain Fine-Tuned Large Language Models: A Paired Audit of Knowledge-Centric Abstention in Biomedical LLMs
articles.summary_en: An arXiv research abstract reports a paired audit of 25 biomedical fine-tuned large language models against 11 corresponding base checkpoints. On MedAbstain, median appropriate abstention fell from 8.3% to 4.2%, with declines in 21 of 25 pairs; the magnitude and direction of change varied across pairs.
articles.summary_zh: arXiv研究摘要指出，研究以11個對應基礎模型檢查點，配對稽核25個生醫領域微調大型語言模型。在MedAbstain基準，適當不作答比例的中位數由8.3%降至4.2%，25組中有21組下降；各配對的變化幅度與方向不一。
articles.title_en: Paired audit finds appropriate abstention can decline after biomedical model fine-tuning
articles.title_zh: 生醫語言模型配對研究：微調後適當不作答表現可能下降
